tradeoffs.loses: OpenAI's best-effort `seed` determinism hint on Router-bound requests (the app never read system_fingerprint, and seed was never a reproducibility guarantee)
tradeoffs.why: Router's Responses API rejects seed, so the runtime keeps every seed-carrying request on OpenAI: without this, no gpt/o-series call in the app can reach Router.

tradeoffs.loses: OpenAI's best-effort `seed` determinism hint on Router-bound ensemble requests (the app never read system_fingerprint, and seed was never a reproducibility guarantee)
tradeoffs.why: Same blocker as T1, for the review-ensemble entry point: Router's Responses API rejects seed, so a seed-carrying request never leaves OpenAI.

tradeoffs.loses: The exact 2024 snapshots: Router serves the undated catalog id, whose weights move when OpenAI refreshes it. gpt-4o-2024-05-13 in particular becomes the current gpt-4o, not the May-2024 build.
tradeoffs.why: Router serves only undated catalog ids and 404s a dated one. Its own equivalence table covers gpt-4o-2024-08-06 and gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 but not these three, so the app's hardcoded reviewer model (gpt-4o-2024-05-13, used in four places) could not reach Router at all.

tradeoffs.loses: The exact May-2024 gpt-4o snapshot for the 5-way review ensemble: Router serves the current undated gpt-4o.
tradeoffs.why: perform_review's ensemble runs on the hardcoded gpt-4o-2024-05-13, which Router 404s as a dated id.

tradeoffs.loses: The exact 2024 snapshots: Router serves the undated catalog id, whose weights move when OpenAI refreshes it. gpt-4o-2024-05-13 becomes the current gpt-4o, not the May-2024 build.
tradeoffs.why: Router serves only undated catalog ids and 404s a dated one. Its own equivalence table covers gpt-4o-2024-08-06 and gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 but not these three, so the app's hardcoded reviewer model could not reach Router at all.

tradeoffs.loses: The exact May-2024 gpt-4o snapshot for the 5-way review ensemble: Router serves the current undated gpt-4o.
tradeoffs.why: perform_review's ensemble runs on the hardcoded gpt-4o-2024-05-13, which Router 404s as a dated id.

tradeoffs.loses: Claude 3.5 Sonnet itself: Router's catalog has no Claude 3.x id, so the app's default model becomes Claude Sonnet 5 -- two generations newer, different outputs, and ideas/reviews are no longer comparable with runs made on 3.5 Sonnet.
tradeoffs.why: claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620 is the app's default --model and drives ideation, novelty checking, writeup and citations. Router cannot serve any Claude 3.x id (404 model_not_found), so without a map the app's primary path stays wholly on Anthropic.
